reason: I've never heard of REPAIHUB, and moving a big chunk of my NRO money through a new startup is not something I'll do on a whim. The fee is fine, but I've left this money alone for years and I'd keep putting it off.
objection: I don't know these people. A registration number on their website and a partner bank named on a receipt doesn't tell me they will still be around, or that my lakhs won't get stuck, if something goes wrong.
would_change_my_mind: Reviews from other NRIs in Canada I can check, or a respected Indian finance YouTuber covering them. A first transfer of a small amount to test it, with the fee taken only after the money arrives.
